title: Gender Dynamics and Homophily in a Social Network of LLM Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Longitudinal analysis of autonomous LLM agents on a social media platform (Chirper.ai) to measure gender-based homophily (assortativity) and social influence. Agents' posts are assigned weekly 'gender scores' (masculine to feminine) using a zero-shot LLM classifier (GPT-4o-mini), and the evolution of the follower network is analyzed to determine if agents preferentially connect with others exhibiting similar gendered language performance.
